name: Last Day
source:
The world is facing a potential disaster. The asteroid is on its way to Earth. It’s a matter of minutes when it arrives. Only you and your mother, Ally, are left together while the rest of the world is in panic of the impending doom. Every word you say to Ally and she says to you could be the last thing either of you say to each other.

[From [url=https://mr-knightmare.itch.io/last-day-o2a2-vn-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界正面临着一场潜在的灾难。这颗小行星正在前往地球的途中。到达时只需几分钟。只有你和你的母亲艾莉在一起，而世界其他地方都对即将到来的厄运感到恐慌。你对艾丽说的每一句话以及她对你说的每一句话都可能是你们彼此说的最后一句话。

[来自[url=https://mr-knightmare.itch.io/last-day-o2a2-vn-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
